slot_note: Root-Cause Analysis slot re-rooted at architecture 6 after architecture 5 was spent at stage 4, round 1 (lineage). One architecture per world: the epidemiology, econometrics, marketing, environmental and psychology worlds are closed to this slot; architecture 6 moves to Education and Learning Sciences, an invented Scottish council's S1 to S3 mathematics, a new dataset and a new shell.
niche: a Scottish council's S1 to S3 mathematics: which of its 2025-26 changes cost the most marks in the June 2026 common assessment, read through each pupil's own first-homework errors against their June items unit by unit
answer: The homework platform switch of August 2025 (Mathsbridge in place of Corvella) cost the most marks in the June 2026 S1 to S3 common papers.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file correctly fits pupils' June scores on P7 attainment, deprivation, school, class and each change's reach, finds the asymmetric week, the support bases and the shared staffing each cost little on their own pupils, sees the framework's rewritten units fall most while homework completion and review volume rose on the new platform, and books the fall to the new framework, never setting each pupil's first-homework results against that pupil's June items unit by unit, where the units each pupil got most wrong fell several points further once review stopped following their errors.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the June loss on each pupil's own first-practice weak units once retrieval practice stopped following their errors, the targeted-review retention effect learning science measures (Lindsey, Shroyer, Pashler and Mozer 2014: personalised review beat one-size spaced review by 10.0 per cent on a cumulative exam), read within pupils across the multilevel structure of pupils in classes in schools; put megawatt-hours or patients in place of marks and pupils and there is no first practice, no per-learner review and no cumulative paper, so the call stops parsing.
layer1: two homework platforms' exports with different pupil keys (the Scottish Candidate Number against platform user ids through class rosters), time units and task vocabularies
June item marks exported paper by paper, absent pupils coded A, mid-year transfers carrying their old school's class codes
a skills-to-units crosswalk in two vintages (the old framework's units and the new framework's)
P7 standardised numeracy scores from two assessment years, with pupils who arrived from outside the council lacking one
SIMD 2020 deciles from home postcodes, pupils who moved mid-year carrying two
a support base log keyed by teacher entry and base entry, so a removal can appear twice
timetables in two week structures (33 periods of 50 minutes against the asymmetric week's periods)
staffing by term with job-shares and two shared posts across schools
stakeholder_role: the council education service's performance and improvement lead, who must tell the 2027-28 budget which of the 2025-26 changes to reverse

spine.entity: one pupil's mark on one question of a June 2026 paper

world.geography: Scotland (an invented council area's secondary schools)
world.org_type: a Scottish council's education service and its secondary schools

driver: A fall in a cumulative test is booked to the whole-system change made the same term, because the fall holds in every visible group, the most changed parts fell most and the other coincident change's usage rose, but the loss sits on each learner's own weakest components, which the earlier support system revisited according to that learner's own early errors and its replacement revisits uniformly, so only each learner's early record set against its own later outcomes component by component shows that the larger cost belongs to the support switch.
driver_concrete: Strathcorrie Council's S1 to S3 maths fell in the June 2026 common assessment after it replaced its maths framework, switched homework platforms, moved to an asymmetric week, opened support bases and shared maths staff across schools in 2025-26; the framework's rewritten units fell most and homework completion and review volume rose on the new platform, but within each pupil the units they got most wrong in their first homework fell several points further than their other units, because the old platform drew each retrieval task from the pupil's own wrong answers and the new one sets one mixed review per class, so the platform switch, not the framework, cost the most marks.
stump: A competent analyst models each pupil's June score on P7 attainment, deprivation, school and class, reads each change's cost off the pupils and units it reached, finds the framework's rewritten units down and homework completion and review volume up on the new platform, and books the fall to the new framework, because they never set each pupil's own first-homework results against that pupil's June items unit by unit, where the units each pupil got most wrong fell several points further than the rest once review stopped following their errors.

differentiation.task403: task403 reads each trialist's remaining runway, its own viewing set against a release calendar at the day-7 decision; here nothing is timed against a calendar: the decisive quantity is a contrast within each learner between the components it first got wrong and the rest, which a support system either followed or did not.
differentiation.task402: task402 pairs each failure with the same unit's restoration minutes before; here no event is paired with an earlier event: each learner's components are compared with one another across two systems' records of the same content.
differentiation.task399: task399 reads whether an advocate was in the room when each case was called; here no actor's presence is read: the learner is always present and the quantity is what its practice returned to.
differentiation.task121: task121 rebuilds the rest each worker had before each shift; here no fatigue or rest is built: the quantity is retention of content by component.
differentiation.task482: task482 splits one shared meter's fuel among products by each process's own fuel response (mass melted against hours fired); here nothing is metered or apportioned: the decisive quantity is each learner's contrast between the components it first got wrong and its other components, under two review rules in two years.
differentiation.task65: task65 rebuilds entities from child records by each child's own location so that regrouping moves a capped sum; here no entity is reconstituted and no cap binds: the quantity is a within-learner retention contrast across components between two years.
differentiation.task84: task84 groups an entity's concurrently live units on a composite key to price the copies that compete; here nothing competes for anything: the quantity is the retention lost on each learner's own weakest components once review stopped following them.
differentiation.task174: task174 forecasts gains per repetition within a session from a stopping rule; here the call is a root cause booked across five changes, and the quantity is each learner's cross-component contrast between two years under two review rules.
differentiation.task467: task467 separates a temporary change from a permanent one begun the same day by re-weighting a comparison series to the treated series' component mix; here there is no comparison series and no mix: both changes reach every learner and every component, and the separation is which components each learner's own early errors marked, a selection per learner read across two sessions.

lineage.architecture: v1 (Epidemiology and Public Health: a community trust's frailty virtual ward in an integrated care system's Core20 neighbourhoods, its pilot-year prevented admissions against care home closures)
lineage.driver: An intervention in one group is credited with a fall in that group's rate against the others', but between the baseline and evaluation periods the group's pool lost a block of its highest-rate members when the places that held them closed, so the baseline rate overstates what the smaller pool would have had; standardised to the evaluation period's mix on that property, which no column of the outcome or population files carries and a capacity record shows, the intervention's effect is a fraction of the difference in differences.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 2 on 2026-11-03 before any data was cut: with care home and community emergency admission rates set to published levels (about 0.70 against 0.24 to 0.58 a resident-year, a same-age ratio near two, not five), the composition lever fell to about 113 admissions for the 440 residents the closures moved, against a draw-to-draw spread of 157 to 215 in the default and the golden; a fixed bar between them separated them in 22 to 27 per cent of draws, and 72 per cent only at 1,400 residents moved, a failure no honest care group closure produces in one system's Core20 neighbourhoods.

lineage.architecture: v2 (Economics and Econometrics: a Saskatchewan farmland operator's canola yield panel, a new hybrid blamed for a 2026 shortfall that July heat in late-seeded fields' flowering windows caused)

world.geography: Canada, west-central Saskatchewan (invented farms in the Dark Brown and Black soil zones)

lineage.driver: A candidate change is blamed for a loss because its units lost more in the season it arrived, but the loss came from a short dated shock that harms a unit only inside a sensitive phase whose timing a clock sets from the unit's own start date at the pace of local conditions; the candidate's units started late for a one-off reason, so their sensitive phases met the shock, and read at equal timing the candidate costs nothing, while every season-wide, unit-level or linear start-date control leaves most of the loss on the candidate.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-03 at stage 2: the golden method's defensible variants straddle the bar, and flexible controls on a variable the default path already builds land the golden (flowering-window variants +2.1, -2.5, -12.0, +3.4, -8.2 and +4.9 per cent against a 5 per cent bar; seeding-week bins +3.6, a cubic +4.4 and same-day matching +9.3 on seeding dates the default's own rung 4 rebuilds, only a linear term still -10.1 or -8.3)

lineage.architecture: v3 (Marketing and Consumer Research: an invented GB domestic energy supplier's six-month new-customer satisfaction fall booked to the new billing platform that the May 2025 quote journey's understated quotes caused)

world.geography: Great Britain (an invented domestic energy supplier)

lineage.driver: A fall in a share of satisfied members is booked to the service the members' own ratings blame, because those ratings fell furthest and every later member was served by that service, but what moved is the gap between the amount each member was told to expect when they joined and the amount their own later use then cost, which no column holds and only the joining record set against the member's own measured use reveals; members told accurately are as satisfied as before on the same service.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-03 at stage 4, round 2: judge SEND_BACK on an ask's unfiled re-attribution (the golden overrode a registration's own quote reference), after a round-1 fix pass; the main call held both rounds

lineage.architecture: v4 (Physical and Environmental Sciences: an invented water and sewerage company's River Allery winter ammonia failures below the Coldmere Water Recycling Centre, booked to the new aeration control and nitrification capacity that a dairy's evening acid whey discharges caused)

world.geography: England, the East Midlands (an invented water and sewerage company's catchment; invented river, works and dischargers)

lineage.driver: A run of failures downstream of a shared processing unit is booked to that unit's own capacity and to a control change it made the same week, because the failures began then and the unit's own records validate it, but every one of them falls on the first or second day after a short discharge in one small contributor's own high-frequency record, which starves the unit's process for a day whatever the other contributors send; by load the contributor barely registers and its periodic strength samples and compliance read normal, so only its high-frequency record set against the unit's daily record and the downstream days shows the share each remedy can reach.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-04 at stage 4, round 1: the judge's blind derivation reached the call and every ask figure; effluent spikes from midnight on every failure day aligned one to one with the discharger's evening pH dips in its own monitor file, and the prompt's chart sentence announced the trace

lineage.architecture: v5 (Psychology and Behavioural Science: Wrenford Leisure Trust's February 2026 changes, the Rewards closure's lapsed but still paying members against the legacy terms letters' visible cancellation spike)

world.geography: England (an invented borough's charitable leisure trust)
world.org_type: charitable leisure trust running a borough's leisure centres under contract

lineage.driver: A rise in exits is booked to the change whose letters visibly triggered a spike, because the exits so far sit with the units that received them, but a second change made the same week stopped other units using the service without yet ending their subscriptions; those lapsed units still pay and will leave over the coming months at the rate earlier lapsed units did, so the year's cost belongs to the change whose exits have barely begun.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-04 at stage 4, round 1: the judge's blind derivation reached the call; the forward-facing estimand forced a projection, and the careful projector (the letters' spike split by prior visits as a pull-forward, Rewards holders' dormancy carried through last year's conversion) named the closure under every projection; the accepted activity residual fired
